wrong.why: Eliel is placed between Jeroham and Toah in Samuel's Kohathite ancestry, corresponding to elihu rather than the supplied Manassite record eliel.

missing.why: Elkanah is called 'his son' immediately after Assir at the end of verse 22.
The ancestry explicitly identifies the Elkanah preceding Amasai as the son of Joel.

note: Owner row 107213 appears to confuse elkanah-4 with elkanah-5 in verse 35, creating a cycle through Amasai and Mahath; it is preserved. Owner rows 105596 and 105603 also appear to conflate the father of Amasai and Ahimoth with the earlier Elkanah identified as Korah's son; they are preserved.
